description: This file defines a Knockout.js ViewModel for a Todo application, managing todos including adding, removing, editing, and persisting them to local storage.

classes.name: ViewModel
classes.description: Main view model managing the list of todos and user interactions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new todo item to the list if the current input is not empty.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified todo from the list.

methods.name: removeCompleted
methods.description: Removes all completed todos from the list.

methods.name: editItem
methods.description: Enables editing mode for a specific todo item.

methods.name: stopEditing
methods.description: Stops editing a todo item, trims the title, and removes it if empty.

methods.name: cancelEditing
methods.description: Cancels editing and reverts the title to its previous value.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns 'item' or 'items' based on the count for display purposes.
